method.sampling: 2048 independent cases per each of ordinary, hot-favored, cold-adverse;6144 paired clusters and18432 outcomes. Uniform ordered pair among306 actual club pairs, uniform six accepted-history prefixes and uniform original orientation sampled independently WITH replacement using separate SHA256 domains and unbiased256-bit integer rejection. Realized pair/history/role counts random; target includes these draws. No balancing after outcomes.
method.ordinary: Actual coach tactics and ratings unchanged. Streaks reconstructed chronologically from32 copied accepted nonvoided tournament results, at empty and five date-complete prefix states. Focal home, temperate18C/55%humidity/wind5/gust10/rain0, neutral traits .5.
method.stress: The two independently selected prior corners remain hot-favored35C/80%humidity and cold-adverse-5C/90%, wind35/gust50/rain5/direction45. Deliberate+/-5 streaks, focal/opponent home and all-squad1vs0 thermal traits as frozen upstream. Stress labels are inputs, not observed winners. No club physiology claim.
method.inference: Six co-primary contrasts: full111 minuscontrol000 and full111 minusHold110 in each of three scenes. IID mixture target, unconditional on pair/history/orientation draws.24 one-sided Clopper-Pearson probability bounds at alpha=.05/24, covering toward/against probabilities and both tails; signed subtraction gives family-wise95% coverage for all six paired differences. Beta PPF endpoints independently checked using a log-space binomial-CDF bisection. Do not condition on random realized counts or pool prior studies.
method.secondary: Every club, history prefix, orientation and rating-gap category retained descriptively; no inferential subgroup ceiling claims or outcome-selected subgroups. Event-derived exposure denominators in every arm.
method.qualification: Excluded72 initial audited outcomes plus72 exactreplays and24 additional native/default-off/Hold parity comparisons,24 first-half pairs,4 deliberate corruption rejections; separate8-worker48-outcome preflight with12 exact replays. Qualification counts verified against receipts.

combinedPsychological.note: Measure confidence, crowd support and frustration together; no duplicate motivation bonuses.

personalMechanisms.note: Halftime decisions and heat/cold traits must be measured, not assumed small; useful tactical changes may have large conditional effects.

criteriaStatus: Existing proposed review references, not newly adopted pass margins. Ordinary5pp, preferredextreme10pp, outerextreme15pp reviewed against signed simultaneous ranges. An interval lying inside a reference supports only this mixture/scenario; it is not universal safety or release approval. No guaranteed positive coaching benefit required.
limits: Healthy availability resets; no cross-match energy, injuries, bans or evolving future-season trajectory. History prefixes accumulate actual past wins/losses only.
Authentic unequal club strength; raw60/65% matched-team references cannot be treated as per-club guarantees.
Counterfactual extremes and fixed weather, not estimated climate or population physiology.
Release still requires isolated season rehearsal, verified competition-scoped pins and explicit approval.
